shots.image_prompt: Bare feet walking along a long, winding dirt path through the sun-drenched Ethiopian highlands at dusk.
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan right to right, fixed horizon

narration.en: Why would a young boy walk twenty kilometres across Ethiopia every Sunday evening just to attend primary school?

shots.subtitle_en: Why would a young boy walk twenty kilometres across Ethiopia every Sunday evening just to attend primary school?
shots.reason: Establishes humble beginnings and immense sacrifice, connecting directly to the youth's own daily struggles.

shots.image_prompt: A mother's weathered hands gently wrapping a young student's hands around a worn wooden pencil beside a warm hearth fire.

narration.en: Gebisa Ejeta was born in Wollonkomi to Oromo parents, encouraged constantly by his mother to pursue education.

shots.subtitle_en: Gebisa Ejeta was born in Wollonkomi to Oromo parents, encouraged constantly by his mother to pursue education.
shots.reason: Evokes deep cultural respect for mothers and the transformative power of quiet family encouragement.

shots.image_prompt: A young man seen from behind, standing at a vista looking out over rich agricultural terraced fields under soft morning light.

narration.en: He intended to study engineering, but his mother convinced him he could accomplish more working in agriculture.

shots.subtitle_en: He intended to study engineering, but his mother convinced him he could accomplish more working in agriculture.
shots.reason: Highlights the critical pivotal choice to dedicate one's life to feeding the land.

shots.image_prompt: Hands wearing clear laboratory gloves holding a glass beaker containing a bright green plant sprout against a softly blurred greenhouse background.

narration.en: After studying at Haramaya University, Ejeta earned his doctorate in plant breeding from Purdue University in 1978.

shots.subtitle_en: After studying at Haramaya University, Ejeta earned his doctorate in plant breeding from Purdue University in 1978.
shots.reason: Shows academic dedication and the transition from traditional farming to world-class scientific inquiry.

shots.image_prompt: Vast cracked dry soil in a drought-stricken plain under a harsh golden sun, with a single resilient green shoot rising from the center.

narration.en: He went to work in rain-starved northern Sudan, researching sorghum crops for five straight years.

shots.subtitle_en: He went to work in rain-starved northern Sudan, researching sorghum crops for five straight years.
shots.reason: Dramatizes the extreme hardship of hunger and drought that science was called upon to solve.

shots.image_prompt: A massive, thriving field of tall golden sorghum swaying under a vibrant blue sky during a rich golden harvest.
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan left to right, fixed horizon

narration.en: His drought-tolerant hybrid produced yields up to 150 percent higher, covering one million acres in Sudan yearly.

shots.subtitle_en: His drought-tolerant hybrid produced yields up to 150 percent higher, covering one million acres in Sudan yearly.
shots.reason: Instills pride by showing the immense visual scale of triumph over crop failure.

shots.image_prompt: A detailed macro view of a healthy golden crop root system growing strong and untouched in deep rich soil.

narration.en: At Purdue, he developed a mechanism to stop parasitic Striga weeds from attacking sorghum crops.

shots.subtitle_en: At Purdue, he developed a mechanism to stop parasitic Striga weeds from attacking sorghum crops.
shots.reason: Focuses on scientific mastery and the elegant solution to a microscopic agricultural threat.

shots.image_prompt: Hands cupping a cascade of golden seed grains pouring into rustic woven burlap sacks stacked on a wooden platform.

narration.en: In 1994, eight tons of his resistant seeds were distributed to twelve African nations.

shots.subtitle_en: In 1994, eight tons of his resistant seeds were distributed to twelve African nations.
shots.reason: Translates abstract scientific discovery into tangible, bountiful reality for a whole continent.

shots.image_prompt: Calloused, hardworking hands holding a massive harvest bundle of ripe grain heads in a sunlit field.

narration.en: Farmers planting them reported crop yields up to four times larger than traditional harvests.

shots.subtitle_en: Farmers planting them reported crop yields up to four times larger than traditional harvests.
shots.reason: Centers the ultimate purpose of the work on empowering local farmers and creating food abundance.

shots.image_prompt: A gleaming gold medal resting on a dark navy velvet cushion lit by a soft spotlight in a grand hall, surrounded by soft bokeh lights.

narration.en: President Biden awarded this scientist from Wollonkomi the National Medal of Science in 2023.

shots.subtitle_en: President Biden awarded this scientist from Wollonkomi the National Medal of Science in 2023.
shots.reason: Leaves the audience with immense inspiration, proving that world-level recognition can start from home.
